what.text: This page follows refugees from South Sudan living in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 56404 South Sudanese refugees there, 2.4% of all refugees from South Sudan.
Uganda hosts the most South Sudanese refugees, followed by Sudan, Ethiopia and Kenya.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of South Sudan from 2011 to 2021, with the SPLM/A - IO among the opponents, and again in 2025.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between South Sudan and Sudan in 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2014 at 1790 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 95704, at the end of 2018, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
These are year-end totals for the Democratic Republic of the Congo only, reported to UNHCR.
